map.name: Pellmire
map.trouble: Mogrut the Ogre and his brutes hold the Sluice Tower across the Sunken Causeway and have shut the way out of the Gloamfen.

guard_bark.specifics: Tobb at the Causeway gate, shut while Mogrut's Ogres hold the Sluice Tower.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: What's this? The Causeway gate is shut by order! You'd better go see Mayor Dobbet if you mean to cross. The Ogres are out there.

again.speaker: Tobb
again.text: Wanna spend a night in the stocks?

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: Fair work at the Sluice Tower. But that don't make you one of the Bog Wardens! Now move along!

bounty_offer.specifics: Gummet, an old walkway-dweller, wants the Leech nest under the Rotten Pilings burned out.

offer.speaker: Gummet
offer.text:
Blast it! Where were you, lad!? The Leeches swarmed up out of the water onto the lower walkways and we'd have lost every one of them if Mayor Dobbet's torchmen were not rushed down the ladders at the very last!

But in all the commotion, the slimy things laid a nest under the pilings, leaving the walkways our smallest worry! All Pellmire is in danger if that nest hatches!

You must go where the Leeches crawled off to, south to the Rotten Pilings! Burn out that nest or we are finished!

reminder.speaker: Gummet
reminder.text: I just know that nest is about to hatch! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Gummet
completion.text:
In happier days, the whole of Pellmire would turn out to celebrate the end of those Leeches! Fine work! But now we must deal with Mogrut and his Ogres once and for all.

Take these as a small thanks from all of us for a brave deed!

journal.text: Go to the Rotten Pilings and destroy the Leech nest.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Nella's uncle's lucky amulet was snatched by the Urchins, who ran to the net sheds.

offer.speaker: Nella
offer.text:
Those Urchins just made off with my uncle's lucky amulet! If it isn't found, he'll be ruined. He's coming home from market tonight!

Oh please, help me, kind stranger! I think the Urchins that grabbed it ran to the net sheds.

Will you... could you find it for me?

refusal.speaker: Nella
refusal.text: Oh.... Then I suppose I'll look for it myself.

reminder.speaker: Nella
reminder.text: Oh, hurry! Uncle's boat could come in any time now!

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text: Oh, thank you, thank you! Please take this as a token of my appreciation!

after.speaker: Nella
after.text: Thanks again for all your help!

journal.text: Retrieve Nella's amulet from the Urchins at the net sheds.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Nella's amulet from the Urchins at the net sheds.

rumour.specifics: Moggs panics, Elsbet swats gnats, Dabb boasts of holding the walkways.

rumour1.speaker: Moggs
rumour1.text: That does it! First the birds go quiet then the Ogres come. Run for the boats!

rumour2.speaker: Elsbet
rumour2.text: Shoo! These gnats won't leave me be!

rumour3.speaker: Dabb
rumour3.text: We've held the walkways! Now we must chase the Ogres out of the whole Gloamfen!

shop_greeting.specifics: Fennick the innkeeper, Bruda the smith, Yvra the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Fennick
inn.text: Mogrut's Ogres have pulled up the north walkway.

arms.speaker: Bruda
arms.text: It's a bit quiet today, with the frog-jumping fair and all.

magic.speaker: Yvra
magic.text: Sorry, I can't serve you. It would spoil my good name.

two_givers.specifics: Warden Ossel posts a bounty on Grelk the Smuggler, dead or alive. Grelk, cornered, surrenders.

offer_a.speaker: Warden Ossel
offer_a.text:
Good day, stranger. I presume you've come about the notice.

There's a fat reward for Grelk the Smuggler -- dead or alive. He and his miserable crew of cutthroats have been robbing our toll boats for a month.

Mind yourself, you don't want a knife in the back from that wretched lot.

offer_b.speaker: Grelk
offer_b.text: Enough! I give up! Don't hit me, please! I'll come along quietly!

outcome_a.speaker: Warden Ossel
outcome_a.text:
Hey, there! Elsbet told me of a terrible racket down this way, so I came to have a look.

You have caught the infamous Grelk the Smuggler all on your own! Most impressive! You have my highest regard! Grelk's crew has plagued Pellmire for a month! I'll handle him now. We'll all rest easier with this rotten villain in the stocks!

And here is your reward -- 200 in gold!

outcome_b.speaker: Warden Ossel
outcome_b.text:
You did away with Grelk, eh? Well, I'd wanted him in the stocks, but I won't shed any tears over the rascal!

Here's your reward -- 100 in gold! Thank you for ridding Pellmire of that pest!

journal_a.text: Bring in Grelk the Smuggler, dead or alive, for Warden Ossel.

journal_b.text: Escort Grelk the Smuggler to Warden Ossel.

rescue.specifics: Grimsel the peat master begs the player to clear the Black Cuttings and free his trapped cutters, Dabb first.

plea.speaker: Grimsel
plea.text:
What kept you!? Something awful has happened!

Giant Spiders and moaning Zombies from the old bog graves have overrun the Black Cuttings. Good cutters have perished in defense of Pellmire's winter peat!

Please, I implore you! Drive the monsters out of the Cuttings, bring back my cutters and you shall be well paid.

This key opens the shed where Dabb is trapped. He can lead you to the others.

I also have a spell book that may come in handy.

reminder.speaker: Grimsel
reminder.text: Come back when my cutters are safe and you'll be paid in full.

found.speaker: Dabb
found.text: Oh, thank goodness somebody came! Get me back to the landing, please.

completion.speaker: Grimsel
completion.text:
You're a real hero! A thousand thanks.

While you were down in the Cuttings, getting my cutters out, Captain Vell stopped by, asking after you. He'll meet you at the Old Landing -- west of here.

Before you leave, take this purse for your trouble.

journal.text: Kill or drive off the monsters in the Black Cuttings. Free the trapped peat cutters.

main_opening.specifics: Moggs shouts for Mayor Dobbet, who sends the player across the Sunken Causeway against Mogrut at the Sluice Tower.

herald.speaker: Moggs
herald.text: Mayor Dobbet! Mayor Dobbet! We've got a visitor!

opening.speaker: Mayor Dobbet
opening.text:
So you've come at last, lad. Pellmire -- oldest stilt village of the whole Gloamfen! Home of the hardy Bog Wardens!

Cross the Sunken Causeway, find the Sluice Tower, then get ready for the fight of your life -- Mogrut the Ogre. He breaks the timid ones.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Dobbet
reminder.text: You'd best be moving on now.

journal.text: Find a way across the Sunken Causeway.
